kicker: Computers compiled into Qwen, wave two

scenes.headline: How a filesystem and a lab fit inside Qwen
scenes.sub: Compiled layers that count in exponents and multiply in state
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Odometer! People keep compiling machines into Qwen. Let's take apart two tricks.

scenes.text: A hybrid model already holds exact storage: DeltaNet rows as registers, an attention log as a file, and a DeltaNet state as a weight matrix.
scenes.say: A hybrid model already holds exact storage: rows as registers, an attention log as a file, a state as a weight matrix.

scenes.title: The Qwenx86 checkpoint, bottom to top

steps.say: First, thirteen compiled layers hold the processor and its memory.
Then sixteen layers that only keep state and never write to the residual stream.
Qwen's own thirty two layers sit on top, unchanged.

scenes.title: A counter in the exponent

parts.say: A segment starts by writing twenty into one cell.
Each later token, the gate shrinks it by the same factor.
So the count lives in the exponent, where bfloat stays precise.

scenes.say: The filesystem must know its place in a file.

steps.say: An anchor token resets the cell, and the gate decays it.
A tiny query keeps the norm below its epsilon, so the value passes straight through.
Six hundred unit pairs each check one threshold. The count that fire is the offset.
The offset joins the key, and attention copies the file back.

scenes.label: tokens before the rebuilt counter stops falling

scenes.title: A weight block in a DeltaNet head
scenes.say: The lab keeps its weights in heads like this.

items.say: Write the block one row per tick, with one-hot keys.
Read the state with the activation as the query.
Out comes the matmul, at fp32 accuracy.
A transposed copy gives the backward pass.

scenes.title: Why the lab changed the layer

left.title: Stock Qwen3.5 head
items: Keeps the direction, loses the scale
left.say: The stock layer normalises the query and loses the activation's size.

right.title: qwenLab bank head
right.say: The lab drops that norm, and the read becomes the matmul.

scenes.text: Pin the gates and norms, and each part of a transformer becomes exact storage of a different kind.
scenes.say: Pin the gates and the norms, and each part of a transformer becomes exact storage.

recap: Counts live in a decaying exponent
A state read can be a matmul
scenes.say: Counts in an exponent, a matmul in a state, and Qwen untouched.
